description: This file defines a PHP class 'ClaimEventAPI' that serves as an API endpoint for managing claim events within a human resource management system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting claim event records, along with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: ClaimEventAPI
classes.description: A PHP API class for managing claim events, providing endpoints to create, retrieve, list, update, and delete claim event records, with validation and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new claim event, initializing a ClaimEvent object with provided parameters and saving it.

methods.name: setClaimEvent
methods.description: Sets properties on a ClaimEvent object from request parameters and saves it via DAO.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of claim events based on search filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method's request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create method's request payload.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the 'name' property, enforcing uniqueness and length constraints.

methods.name: getClaimEventCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates an EntityUniquePropertyOption to customize uniqueness validation for ClaimEvent's 'name' property.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes claim events by provided IDs after validating their existence.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete method's request parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description:
Retrieves a specific claim event by ID, including a check if it is used elsewhere.
Returns canEdit status based on whether the event is used.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for the getOne method's request parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing claim event, including restrictions if the event is already used.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for the update method's request parameters.
